def divisors(n):
    ans = set()
    i = 1
    while i * i <= n:
        if n % i == 0:
            ans.add(i)
            ans.add(n // i)
        i += 1
    return sorted(list(ans))

mod = 10 ** 9 + 7
p, k = [int(x) for x in input().split()]
if k == 0:
    print(pow(p, p - 1, mod))
elif k == 1:
    print(pow(p, p, mod))
else:
    for z in divisors(p - 1):
        if ((p - 1) % z == 0) and (pow(k, z, p) == 1):
            print(pow(p, (p - 1) // z, mod))
            break
